justification: Inspected `byte-buddy-dep/src/main/java/net/bytebuddy/build/Plugin.java` (lines 3480-3545, 3928-3933) and `byte-buddy-gradle-plugin/android-plugin/src/main/java/net/bytebuddy/build/gradle/android/ByteBuddyLocalClassesEnhancerTask.java` (lines 448-463). `ForJarOutputStream` is a small internal adapter with one constructor and three I/O methods, and it only depends on a few low-level types (`JarOutputStream`, `JarEntry`, `InputStream`, `Map`, and Byte Buddy model types). Repository search found only two direct instantiations in `Plugin.java` and one subclass (`ForAndroidAppOutputStream`) in the Android plugin, so the class does not show the high fan-in/high fan-out expected of a hub-like modularization smell.
